verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a personal AI agent, since comparable agents can be run on a user's own infrastructure, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only a vendor-hosted, invite-only service reached through app.instinct.com and its Mac and mobile apps. Nothing in the pack documents a self-hostable deployment, an open-source release, or on-prem installation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
